== Summary ==
[[Tim Ellington]] at the Lord of the Rings Design-a-card Seminar, [[DecipherCon 2002]]. Cropped to him from Decipher's gallery photo ms21 (the uncropped original is [[:File:Chuck Kallenbach DecipherCon 2002 seminar.jpg]]); brightness raised, not resized.

* '''Source:''' [http://decipher.com/deciphercon/2002/photos/pages/ms21.html DecipherCon 2002 photos: ms21], Decipher (2002). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20021221202659/http://decipher.com/deciphercon/2002/photos/pages/ms21.html Internet Archive]. Image: [https://web.archive.org/web/20021221202659id_/http://decipher.com/deciphercon/2002/photos/pictures/ms21.jpg ms21.jpg] (Wayback 21 December 2002; SHA-1 matches the uncropped wiki file).
* '''Photographer:''' unknown (Decipher convention coverage). Photo: Decipher.
* '''Date:''' 31 October – 3 November 2002
* '''Event:''' [[DecipherCon 2002]]
* '''Identification:''' Decipher caption: "Designers Tim Ellington and Chuck Kallenbach consider a Legolas image in the Lord of the Rings Design-a-card Seminar." Two people are named. [[Chuck Kallenbach]] is the seated man with glasses (compare [[:File:Chuck Kallenbach.png]]), so Tim Ellington is the standing man on the left.

== Licensing ==
Non-free. Fair-use rationale: a small crop of a 640 by 480 convention photograph published by Decipher on decipher.com in 2002, used only to identify a Decipher game designer on his article on a non-commercial fan wiki. No free photograph of him from his Decipher years is known, and the crop cannot harm any market for the original.

== Preservation ==
archive.org copy of this exact original (SHA-1 checked by archive.org): [https://archive.org/download/swccg-wiki-images-a/a1/Tim_Ellington_DecipherCon_2002.jpg Internet Archive item].
